## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive (Internal Rotation). Confirmations: Industrials and Financials are ABOVE TREND while large-cap Technology shows mixed signals (multiple majors in RECOVERY or BELOW TREND); leadership is concentrated (Top 5 across 3 sectors), and there is a MAJOR divergence among big caps — treat signals as mixed.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%), GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +24.84%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.96% | 1M: +2.28%). Materials strong: NEM RECOVERY (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%), and Financials firm: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%).  

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -8.62%), PSX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -7.02%). Communication and Consumer Staples show pockets of weakness with META BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -7.05%) and WMT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -11.41%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%), NEM RECOVERY (1W: +13.91% | 1M: -3.58%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors) — not broad.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -9.98% | 1M: -7.68%), SLB BELOW TREND (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -11.47%), PSX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -7.02%), COP BELOW TREND (1W: -7.26% | 1M: -10.70%). Weakness concentrated in Energy and select high-multiple Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers include AMAT (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%), LRCX (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +11.95%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%). Watch divergences: NEM (RECOVERY) shows big 1W gain vs negative 1M and AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -0.63%) could be an early trend shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed: Semi-equipment and select chips are driving strength (AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.28% | 1M: +21.73%)) while large-cap software/cloud names are weak (MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -10.34%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%)). Sector performance is internally rotating with mixed leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +7.78%), V RECOVERY (1W: +2.30% | 1M: -0.68%). Financials are a relative source of strength and support the market’s internal rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/soft short-term: PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +2.33%) but JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +2.89%) and LLY CORRECTION (1W: -2.14% | 1M: +12.54%) show short-term pullbacks inside longer monthly strength; overall sector 1W is slightly negative.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Industrials and select Financials (CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +10.65%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%)) and to semi-capex beneficiaries (AMAT ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to weak Energy names (XOM BELOW TREND, CVX BELOW TREND) and high-multiple software that remain BELOW TREND; style is mixed with a modest Value/Cyclical tilt while awaiting tech clarification.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%). BEARISH: ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%), XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -12.31%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -1.65%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (Sector 1W: +5.82%) and Financials (Sector 1W: +3.74%) given above-trend leaders. BEARISH: Energy (Sector 1W: -6.45%) and pockets of Communication/Software where large-cap weakness persists.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch AMAT for sustained weekly follow-through to confirm the ABOVE TREND breakout and LRCX to extend semicap leadership; watch ADBE weekly closes beneath recent support to confirm continuation of BELOW TREND weakness; monitor JPM to hold above recent breakout levels to extend ABOVE TREND momentum and NVDA/V recovery follow-through to validate tech stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (+80): Phase 3 myeloma win — JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -1.80% | 1M: +2.89%) — news supports the 1M trend but short-term pullback; watch for 1W confirmation. INTC (+60): Apple partnership headline — INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +11.95%) — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. VST (+60): Preferred power provider for large AI build — VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.65% | 1M: +16.15%) — sentiment and price are aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-55): Exec exit / AI concerns — META BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -7.05%) — sentiment confirmed by price weakness. ADBE (-45): Disappointing quarter headlines — ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -23.22%) — clear confirmation. ORCL (-40): Cloud deal frictions — ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -1.65%) — sentiment aligns with recent weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style and a modest Value/Cyclical tilt. AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.30% | 1M: +43.54%), LRCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.36% | 1M: +34.71%) and JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.87% | 1M: +10.88%) are showing clear strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (MSFT BELOW TREND; NVDA RECOVERY; AAPL RECOVERY) and mixed news flow (JNJ positive vs META negative) — watch for confirmation before enlarging directional exposure.
